title: FreeMerchant
tagline: The definitive App for crypto financial inclusion in crisis countries.
description: Argentina, among many other countries, is experiencing a constant devaluation of the peso, with strong exchange control, the inhabitants cannot access currencies such as the dollar to prevent inflation. That's why we created FreeMerchant, a wallet with accountant abstraction that allows you to log in with your email and access an address instantly. We also integrated stripe to allow easy access to tokens, and a QR so merchants can collect their sales instantly with their devices.
how_its_made: Our wallet uses ERC-4337: Account Abstraction to create an address with your personal email, we integrate Stripe so that obtaining stable coins is as simple as purchasing on Amazon. We also created a dynamite QR so you don't have to share the address manually. We use Nextjs + Taildwin for the frontend.
